title: Workspace command context is opaque event-time evidence
summary: Wire UI Server v0.17 requires elements carrying slots.workspaceRef to return an exact UI_ACTION.detail.workspaceContext. The context binds current query/scope/order/selection revisions, selected semantic identities and result-freshness evidence. Swing must preserve and echo this server-projected context; it must never manufacture it from local table/list state.
invariants: workspaceContext is server-owned semantic evidence, not renderer-derived state.
Capture/deep-freeze workspaceContext at the same event-time boundary as renderedRevision.
Do not replace queued action context with a newer context if patches arrive before transport drains the action.
Local JList/JTable selection cannot forge or widen selectedIds.
A workspaceRef mismatch, absent required context, or otherwise unusable context must fail closed locally rather than emitting a superficially valid command.
Unknown future context fields are preserved opaquely so renderer releases do not need to understand every server freshness field.
Server v0.17 resultRevision/resultQueryRevision/resultScopeRevision/resultOrderRevision/resultCurrent must cross the existing workspaceContext seam unchanged.
procedure: Project/store the exact workspaceContext associated with the actionable semantic instance.
On explicit activation, deep-freeze the projected context together with viewRef/renderedRevision.
Let the server perform authoritative stale/forged/result-current validation before dispatch.

provenance.claim: Exact current workspace command context fields including result freshness evidence.
